note: Results from the offline model comparison study in notebooks/Analysis.ipynb (Phase 4: 10-model comparison, Phase 5: hyperparameter tuning). Not recomputed live in the app -- this is a static reference of validated results, consistent with decoupling the offline study from online model serving.
phase5_tuning_note: RandomizedSearchCV + GridSearchCV tuned Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost. None beat Phase 4's untuned Gradient Boosting on the held-out test set (best tuned: XGBoost F1 0.653 vs Gradient Boosting F1 0.656) -- an honest negative result, kept as-is rather than discarded.
winner_selection_criterion: F1 score on churn class (balances catching churners against not over-flagging false positives)
